name: Komodo Periphery
description: A Docker LXC with the native Komodo Periphery agent, connecting to an existing Core for centralized container and Compose stack management.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_core_address
app_vars.label: Komodo Core URL
app_vars.help: Reachable HTTP or HTTPS Core URL, such as https://komodo.example.com.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_server_name
app_vars.label: Komodo Server Name
app_vars.help: Server name in Core; defaults to the guest hostname.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_onboarding_key
app_vars.label: Server Onboarding Key
app_vars.help: Create a Server Onboarding Key in Komodo Core before installation.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_core_public_key
app_vars.label: Core Public Key
app_vars.help: Optional Core public key; defaults to trusting and pinning the first Core in /etc/komodo/keys/core.pub.

notes.text: Run the CT creator on Proxmox VE. It creates a Debian LXC, installs Docker/Compose and runs Periphery natively under systemd.
Create an onboarding key in Core before installation, then confirm the server is connected. See the linked documentation for onboarding and authentication.
Run update_komodo_periphery for the latest stable agent. Configuration, keys and stack data are retained under /etc/komodo; the guest's existing update command is preserved.
ARM64 has not been tested. The installer asks for confirmation before attempting it.
